methodology: Comparative benchmark against O-TRAVELZ 154 transit routes, road-following geometry, candidate vs verified markers, custom atlas styling, offline capability, licensing, and runtime costs.

evaluations.name: MapLibre Native (Android) + MapLibre Native (iOS)
evaluations.architecture: Open-source MapLibre Native C++ core wrapped in Android and iOS SDKs. Shared vector style JSON.

ratings.transit_routes_154_polylines: EXCELLENT — vector line layers handle 154 routes with ease
ratings.custom_atlas_styling: EXCELLENT — full control over GL JSON stylesheet (Sandstone/Slate)
ratings.ios_native_integration: MODERATE — requires third-party MapLibre iOS framework; larger binary size (~25MB added); missing native SwiftUI camera conveniences
ratings.android_native_integration: MODERATE — MapLibre Compose is community-maintained; lacks official Google Maps gesture feel
ratings.tile_infrastructure_cost: HIGH BURDEN — requires maintaining or paying for vector tile hosting (MapTiler, Stadia, or self-hosted PMTiles on R2)
ratings.long_term_maintenance: MODERATE — dependent on open-source community release cadence

evaluations.ponytail_assessment: While stylistically elegant, requiring a custom vector tile hosting infrastructure and heavy third-party C++ libraries on both platforms violates the zero-cost, standard-platform ethos.

evaluations.name: Google Maps SDK (Android) + Apple MapKit (iOS) [SELECTED]
evaluations.architecture: Platform-native first-party SDKs on both systems. Google Maps Compose on Android; Apple MapKit (SwiftUI.Map) on iOS.

ratings.transit_routes_154_polylines: VERY GOOD — native Polyline on Google Maps Compose; MapPolyline on SwiftUI.Map
ratings.custom_atlas_styling: EXCELLENT — JSON Cloud Styling on Google Maps; SwiftUI.Map standard / hybrid with custom tint and dark mode
ratings.offline_vector_tiles: MODERATE — basemap tiles rely on provider caching; O-TRAVELZ overlays and stops cached locally in Room/SwiftData
ratings.licensing_and_cost: FREE ($0.00) — Google Maps SDK for mobile provides UNLIMITED free dynamic map loads (verified Sep 2026 pricing). Apple MapKit is 100% free with Apple Developer account.
ratings.ios_native_integration: SUPERIOR — zero binary bloat, first-party Metal acceleration, native SwiftUI MapReader, Dynamic Type support, 60fps
ratings.android_native_integration: SUPERIOR — official Google Play Services, com.google.maps.android:maps-compose:4.4.1, hardware acceleration, familiar gesture handling
ratings.tile_infrastructure_cost: ZERO ($0.00) — Google and Apple provide global basemap tiles for free on native mobile
ratings.long_term_maintenance: HIGHEST — zero third-party bridge fragility; first-party platform support guaranteed

evaluations.ponytail_assessment: The clear winner. Standard platform libraries, $0.00 runtime cost, zero server tile hosting maintenance, zero binary bloat on iOS, and best-in-class hardware acceleration on both platforms.

evaluations.name: MapLibre Native (Android) + Apple MapKit (iOS)
evaluations.architecture: Asymmetric hybrid: MapLibre on Android, native MapKit on iOS.

ratings.custom_atlas_styling: DISCORDANT — MapLibre uses Mapbox GL JSON styles, MapKit uses Apple styles
ratings.offline_vector_tiles: SPLIT — Android offline capable via PMTiles; iOS depends on Apple MapKit
ratings.licensing_and_cost: LOW — free MapKit on iOS, free MapLibre on Android, but Android tile hosting has operational costs
ratings.tile_infrastructure_cost: MODERATE — tile server required solely for Android client
ratings.long_term_maintenance: POOR — worst of both worlds: two completely different map architectures, two different styling tools, zero synergy

evaluations.ponytail_assessment: REJECTED. Maximum cognitive overhead with asymmetric operational complexity.

decision.free_turn_by_turn_strategy: Zero-cost external handoff via Google Maps Universal URLs (and Apple Maps URL scheme on iOS) — $0 routing cost
decision.tile_hosting_cost_savings: Eliminates need for paid tile servers on mobile; Web remains on MapLibre GL JS where commercial vector tiles are evaluated separately
